stops.note: 'day of Mars'; Tacitus's Germania (AD 98) says the Germans worship gods he calls Mercury, Hercules and Mars
Mars was matched with the Germanic war god Tiw (Norse Týr), so his day became Tiw's day
Shrove Tuesday, the eve of Lent, is Pancake Day; the pancake race at Olney in Buckinghamshire claims to go back to 1445

current_meaning: the day of the week after Monday
